name: .264 Cal-097gr Absolute Hammer™
note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "Based on the success of the 99gr Hammer Hunter, this 97gr Absolute Hammer™ will be a ton of really fast fun. A stiff dose of Ramshot Tac or rl-15 should get this one close to 3500 fps in the Creedmoor. The Absolute Hammer™s do not line up with conventional load data so only experienced re-loaders that can read pressure signs well should attempt to load these."
